question: In one-definition nested NAE families alive only in the usual limit, is the least bond along one ray between a top port and a depth-s distinction bounded or growing, and at what exact eventual rate?

definitions.families: the 664 one-definition genuine families of LIMIT-ONLY's records
definitions.method: ray DP over (F, G) families of interface-state sets; L(s) to s = 30 or a repeat
definitions.classes: bounded; growing; no ray bond; undetermined

public_inputs.code: census.py (sha256 bba5f4f187dec802ebb3f457d1183fe6ffb72d7517bcb11ba0f2eed2841c8ca2) beside this file; LIMIT-STATE census.py; SHORT-DESC dlang.py; numpy; pysat.
public_inputs.run: census.py --run W 8 for W in 0-7, then --summary, from the repository root.

forbidden_inputs: Changing the method, endpoints, classes, predictions or decision rules after seeing registered results
primary_observable: Share of families with bounded least ray bonds; growth rates.
cheapest_meaningful_control: Chains with no cycle of knots (L = steps apart + 2, proved) and brute force at small depths.
validation_gate: 120 of 120 brute-force cases agree; chains give steps apart + 2 (done before freezing).
stop_rule: One run and its summary; a hand-off to the referee thread; report.
